mapper.sql: p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.body_markdown, p.cover_media_asset_id, p.status, p.published_at, p.withdrawn_at, p.created_by_account_id, p.updated_by_account_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at

where.if: AND (LOWER(p.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR LOWER(p.slug) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_blog_post_tag pt WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND pt.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_blog_topic_post tp WHERE tp.post_id = p.id AND tp.topic_id = #{topicId})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_blog_post SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = COALESCE(published_at, #{publishedAt}), withdrawn_at = NULL, updated_by_account_id = #{updatedByAccountId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'WITHDRAWN')
UPDATE sr_blog_post SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = #{withdrawnAt}, updated_by_account_id = #{updatedByAccountId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
DELETE FROM sr_blog_post WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'WITHDRAWN')
mapper.select: SELECT YEAR(published_at) AS `year`, MONTH(published_at) AS `month`, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM sr_blog_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY YEAR(published_at), MONTH(published_at) ORDER BY `year` DESC, `month` DESC
SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM sr_blog_post p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_blog_topic_post tp JOIN sr_blog_topic top ON top.id = tp.topic_id WHERE tp.post_id = p.id AND top.slug = #{topicSlug}) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
